title: Healthcare Data Analyst Academy — Platform Roadmap

legend.completed: Implemented in the cumulative Academy release
legend.partial: Some supporting capability exists; full requirement remains
legend.pending: Not implemented as a complete capability
legend.verify: Requires independent validation or real-environment testing

items.title: Eight-volume curriculum and 111 mapped chapters
items.detail: Core curriculum structure spans foundations, tools, statistics, clinical analytics, BI/data engineering, advanced analytics and career practice.

items.title: Interactive labs, assessments and job simulations
items.detail: Multiple SQL, Excel, statistics, practicum, assessment and project modules exist.

items.title: Responsive offline-first HTML experience
items.detail: Local HTML/JS modules and responsive patterns exist; exhaustive Android browser/device testing is not evidenced.
items.evidence: Static implementation exists; device QA remains.

items.title: Unified progress, backup and restore across every module
items.detail: Some modules maintain their own browser storage. A single cross-module backup/restore contract is not yet demonstrated.

items.title: Disease-agnostic clinical analytics framework
items.detail: Clinical and pharmacy content exists, but there is no proven universal workflow engine covering arbitrary disease domains.
items.evidence: Clinical, pharmacy, research and RWE modules exist.

items.title: Study-design workflow templates
items.detail: Research and epidemiology learning content exists; reusable operational templates for cohort, case-control, cross-sectional, RCT, diagnostic accuracy, registry and longitudinal studies remain to be consolidated.

items.title: Configurable study protocol and variable dictionary
items.detail: Create study-specific data dictionaries, eligibility rules, outcome definitions, visit schedules and analysis plans.

items.title: Reusable cohort and endpoint definition engine
items.detail: Represent index date, look-back, follow-up, censoring, competing events and outcome windows as explicit reusable rules.

items.title: Curriculum, glossary and learning checkpoints
items.detail: The Academy has mapped chapters, glossary terms and module-specific checkpoints.

items.title: Context-aware on-click dictionary everywhere
items.detail: A glossary exists, but a universal term resolver across every module, code sample and chart is not demonstrated.
items.evidence: Glossary exists; global inline linking pending.

items.title: Concept prerequisites and adaptive explanations
items.detail: Connect concepts to prerequisites, examples, misconceptions, exercises and mastery checks.

items.title: Spaced repetition and knowledge retention
items.detail: Schedule retrieval practice from mistakes and low-confidence concepts.

items.title: Executable Python and SQLite learning labs
items.detail: Multiple local labs and reference pipelines are executable and have tests.
items.evidence: v5.8 database and v5.10 pipeline QA.

items.title: Data quality, governance and lineage exercises
items.detail: Profiling, rule checks, quarantine, checksums, manifests and governance materials are included.

items.title: Universal study validation engine
items.detail: Build configurable checks for eligibility, missingness, duplicates, date logic, range plausibility, endpoint derivation and analysis assumptions.

items.title: Evidence provenance and clinical reference versioning
items.detail: Some source and lineage practices exist; a maintained, versioned evidence registry with guideline dates and claim-level citations is not yet demonstrated.

items.title: Independent statistical and clinical review gates
items.detail: Add protocol-to-analysis traceability, independent calculation checks and qualified domain review for clinical claims.

items.title: AI integration architecture and provider-neutral interface
items.detail: Define adapters, capability discovery, model routing, structured outputs, timeouts and provider fallback.

items.title: Cloud AI provider adapters
items.detail: Support multiple providers through configurable API adapters; keep keys outside browser storage.

items.title: Local AI integration
items.detail: Support local inference endpoints such as Ollama-compatible APIs, with model and hardware capability checks.

items.title: RAG over approved learning and evidence library
items.detail: Use indexed documents, chunk provenance, source links, versioning and citation checks.

items.title: Human approval, audit logs and safety boundaries
items.detail: Require review for generated analyses, clinical interpretations, external actions and financial records.

items.title: Local HTML application usable without a server
items.detail: The Academy is distributed as local HTML, CSS and JavaScript assets.

items.title: Android-first responsive and touch optimisation
items.detail: Responsive patterns exist; touch targets, small-screen tables, keyboard handling and Android browser QA need a formal test matrix.

items.title: Cross-browser compatibility suite
items.detail: Test Chromium, Firefox, Safari/WebKit and Android browser variants with defined acceptance criteria.

items.title: Accessibility and low-bandwidth performance
items.detail: Keyboard navigation, screen-reader labels, contrast, reduced motion, lazy loading and performance budgets.

items.title: Portfolio and Git/GitHub learning materials
items.detail: The Academy includes portfolio engineering, publication and career preparation content.

items.title: Actual repository integration and sync
items.detail: Implement authenticated GitHub workflows through a safe backend or GitHub App; never embed tokens in client HTML.
items.evidence: Educational content is not a live integration.

items.title: Automated CI, tests and release manifests
items.detail: Local QA and release packaging are performed; a maintained GitHub Actions pipeline is not verified.
items.evidence: Release QA exists; hosted CI pending.

items.title: Issue tracking, changelog and rollback policy
items.detail: Release notes exist in some modules; unified issue and release governance needs formalisation.

items.title: Career-focused curriculum and portfolio path
items.detail: Learning architecture is aligned to healthcare analytics skills, projects and remote-work preparation.

items.title: Unified learner profile and adaptive roadmap
items.detail: Progress and personal workflow elements exist; unified profile, competency graph and adaptive recommendations remain incomplete.

items.title: Income and expense tracker
items.detail: Create private local ledger, categories, monthly budgets, project income, recurring expenses and CSV export.

items.title: Learning-to-earning ROI dashboard
items.detail: Track hours, project costs, certificates, applications, interviews, paid work and net income without conflating forecasts with actuals.

risks.title: Clinical overgeneralisation
risks.problem: A single disease-specific workflow cannot safely represent all diseases and study designs.
risks.solution: Use configurable protocol templates and a study-design ontology; require explicit definitions for population, exposure, comparator, outcome, time and analysis.

risks.title: AI hallucination and unsupported clinical claims
risks.problem: Generated answers may invent references, misread units or overstate causal conclusions.
risks.solution: Retrieval with source provenance, claim-level citations, deterministic calculations, schema validation and human sign-off.

risks.title: Browser-only secrets exposure
risks.problem: Embedding cloud API keys or GitHub tokens in local JavaScript exposes credentials.
risks.solution: Use a local companion service or secure backend; OAuth/device flow and OS credential storage; never persist secrets in localStorage.

risks.title: False confidence from untested platform claims
risks.problem: A passing syntax test does not prove Android, Safari, Power BI, DAX or clinical correctness.
risks.solution: Publish a capability matrix distinguishing implemented, locally executed, integration-tested and independently validated.

risks.title: Fragmented progress and local data
risks.problem: Independent modules can lose or duplicate progress and financial records.
risks.solution: Define versioned shared data contracts, export/import, migrations and explicit backup/restore tests.

risks.title: Privacy and re-identification risk
risks.problem: Clinical datasets can contain direct and indirect identifiers even after obvious names are removed.
risks.solution: Synthetic fixtures by default, de-identification checks, minimum-necessary access, local-only defaults and privacy review.

risks.title: Mobile performance and dense layouts
risks.problem: Large tables, charts and long pages can be difficult on phones.
risks.solution: Responsive cards, progressive disclosure, pagination, search, lazy rendering and device-based performance budgets.

risks.title: Financial tracking data integrity
risks.problem: Forecasts, unpaid invoices and actual cash receipts can be confused.
risks.solution: Separate planned, invoiced, received and refunded states; immutable transaction IDs and reconciliation.

risks.title: GitHub token and repository access
risks.problem: Direct browser integration can leak credentials or grant excessive permissions.
risks.solution: Least-privilege GitHub App permissions, short-lived tokens, explicit user consent and audit logs.

future.name: Universal study workspace
future.why: Make one platform work across disease areas, data types and study designs.
future.deliver: Protocol builder, study-design templates, variable dictionary, cohort rules, outcome definitions and reproducible analysis plan.

future.name: Evidence and accuracy engine
future.why: Separate deterministic computation from explanatory AI and make claims auditable.
future.deliver: Reference registry, source versioning, calculation tests, unit checks, statistical assumption checks and review gates.

future.name: AI orchestration layer
future.why: Avoid dependence on one model provider or internet connectivity.
future.deliver: Provider adapters, local model endpoint, cloud routing, RAG, structured outputs, evaluation suite and audit trail.

future.name: Mobile-first application shell
future.why: Make the Academy comfortable on Android as well as desktop browsers.
future.deliver: PWA/offline cache, installable shell, responsive data views, accessible interactions and cross-browser test suite.

future.name: Universal contextual dictionary
future.why: Turn every technical term into an explorable learning moment.
future.deliver: Click/tap definitions, pronunciation, plain-language explanation, formula, example, related terms and source.

future.name: GitHub-native development workflow
future.why: Enable real version control and reproducible releases rather than only teaching Git.
future.deliver: Repository connection, branch/commit workflow, issue sync, CI and release artifacts using secure authentication.

future.name: Personal command centre
future.why: Connect learning, competencies, projects, career activity and finances.
future.deliver: Profile, goals, adaptive roadmap, application tracker, income/expense ledger and ROI dashboard.

future.name: Interoperability and reusable data connectors
future.why: Reduce manual import work and support realistic healthcare datasets.
future.deliver: CSV/XLSX, SQLite/PostgreSQL, FHIR/HL7 learning connectors, terminology mapping and validation adapters.
